scope: Retain V584 independent preparation and bounded three-credit FIFO. Build an automatic refill margin after genuine late input, retain its phase, and select the native runtime cycle near the physical handoff with an adaptive observed Wait/Begin budget. All common SteamVR generator routes.
headset_validation: Pending owner Valhalla V584/V585 comparison. Tests prove ownership, finite irregular-input delivery and scheduling; complete compositor visibility is not established by a mock or successful End.
refill_policy: Source tardiness contributes its exact observed deficit as additional refill margin after delivering the late frame. Ordinary late displacement is retained too. The next deadline includes that extra margin once, then returns to one physical period per available output. An individual refill is bounded by capacity-minus-one physical periods,22.222222ms at90Hz with three credits, so a paused producer cannot create a many-second replay stall. This is not a fixed latency ceiling or a per-frame delay; cumulative phase stays held. No fixed30ms setting or requirement to fill every refresh.
source_readiness: Record acceptance before input publication. When a source fence is still pending at dequeue, use its observed completion time before the real-chain lease gate. Already-complete dequeued input uses its acceptance lower bound; time spent behind preparation/real-chain leases must not masquerade as new source lateness.
runtime_cycle: Schedule native Wait/Begin near the handoff using the observed native cost plus100us metadata lead. A longer call increases the next overlap budget immediately; excess budget decays by1/16 per cycle. Raw runtime displayTime remains unchanged. Preparation still overlaps native Wait. Actual physical End spacing remains >= the headset period, never period-minus-margin.
